title: OpenAI says frontier models found critical PHP flaws before attackers did
friendlyTitle: OpenAI says its models found serious PHP bugs before attackers did
summary: OpenAI says that over the past two months it coordinated a response to critical vulnerabilities in PHP, the language that runs a large share of the web. It says Calif found one flaw with GPT-5.6 Sol under the Patch the Planet effort, and that Wiz independently found and reported both issues. PHP's maintainers led the fixes and the release. OpenAI has also published a Codex skill that checks which PHP version a host is running.
friendlySummary: OpenAI says that over the past two months it helped coordinate a response to serious security flaws in PHP, the language that runs a large share of websites. It says a researcher found one flaw with GPT-5.6 Sol, as part of a project called Patch the Planet. Wiz, a security company, found and reported both issues on its own. PHP's maintainers led the fixes and the release. OpenAI has also published a small tool that checks which PHP version a computer is running.
whyItMatters: If you run PHP, the useful step is to apply the maintainers' official update, not to wait for a write-up of the bug. OpenAI's own note is that the same models can help attackers once a flaw is public. A version check is a start. It is not a substitute for the vendor patch.
